description: Azure RBAC Catalog - Comprehensive Application Monitoring Dashboard

azureLogAnalytics.query:
requests
| where timestamp > ago(5m)
| where toint(resultCode) < 500
| count
| extend status = iff(Count > 0, 1, 0)
| project status

requests
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| summarize total = count(), successful = countif(toint(resultCode) < 500)
| extend availability = round(todouble(successful) / todouble(total) * 100, 4)
| project availability

requests
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| count

requests
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where toint(resultCode) >= 500
| count

requests
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| summarize total = count(), failed = countif(toint(resultCode) >= 500)
| extend error_rate = round(todouble(failed) / todouble(total) * 100, 2)
| project error_rate

requests
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where name !contains "mcp"
| summarize avg(duration)

requests
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where name !contains "mcp"
| summarize percentile(duration, 95)

requests
| where name !contains "mcp"
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| summarize percentile(duration, 99)

requests
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| summarize Requests = count() by bin(timestamp, $__interval)
| order by timestamp asc

requests
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| summarize total = count(), success = countif(toint(resultCode) < 500) by bin(timestamp, $__interval)
| extend Availability = round(todouble(success) / todouble(total) * 100, 2)
| project timestamp, Availability
| order by timestamp asc

requests
| where resultCode startswith "2" or resultCode startswith "3"
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| extend endpoint = case(
    name has "GET /roles/" and name !has "recommend", "GET /roles/{id}",
    name has "GET /roles" and name !has "recommend", "GET /roles",
    name has "GET /operations/", "GET /operations/{id}",
    name has "GET /operations", "GET /operations",
   // name has "POST /recommend" or name has "GET /recommend", "/recommend",
    name has "GET /analytics", "GET /analytics",
    name has "GET /about", "GET /about",
    //name has "GET /api/roles", "API: /api/roles",
    //name has "GET /api/operations", "API: /api/operations",
    name has "GET /api/", "API: Other",
    name has "GET /static", "Static Assets",
    name has "GET / ", "GET / (Home)",
    name has "GET /healthz", "Healthcheck",
    name
)
| summarize count() by endpoint//, resultCode

requests
|where name !contains "/mcp"
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| extend endpoint = case(
    name has "GET /roles/" and name !has "recommend", "GET /roles/{id}",
    name has "GET /roles" and name !has "recommend", "GET /roles",
    name has "GET /operations/", "GET /operations/{id}",
    name has "GET /operations", "GET /operations",
   // name has "POST /recommend" or name has "GET /recommend", "/recommend",
    name has "GET /analytics", "GET /analytics",
    name has "GET /about", "GET /about",
   // name has "GET /api/roles", "API: /api/roles",
   // name has "GET /api/operations", "API: /api/operations",
    name has "GET /api/", "API: Other",
    name has "GET /static", "Static Assets",
    name has "GET / ", "GET / (Home)",
    name has "GET /healthz", "Healthcheck",
    name
)
| summarize 
    requests = count(),
    p95_ms = round(percentile(duration, 95), 1),
    p99_ms = round(percentile(duration, 99), 1),
    avg_ms = round(avg(duration), 1)
  by endpoint
| where requests > 3

requests
|where resultCode !startswith "2" and resultCode !startswith "3"
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| extend endpoint = case(
    name has "GET /roles/" and name !has "recommend", "GET /roles/{id}",
    name has "GET /roles" and name !has "recommend", "GET /roles",
    name has "GET /operations/", "GET /operations/{id}",
    name has "GET /operations", "GET /operations",
   // name has "POST /recommend" or name has "GET /recommend", "/recommend",
    name has "GET /analytics", "GET /analytics",
    name has "GET /about", "GET /about",
    //name has "GET /api/roles", "API: /api/roles",
    //name has "GET /api/operations", "API: /api/operations",
    name has "GET /api/", "API: Other",
    name has "GET /static", "Static Assets",
    name has "GET / ", "GET / (Home)",
    name has "GET /healthz", "Healthcheck",
    name
)
| summarize count() by endpoint, resultCode

requests
| where resultCode startswith "2"
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where name !contains "mcp"
| extend endpoint = case(
    name has "GET /roles/" and name !has "recommend", "GET /roles/{id}",
    name has "GET /roles" and name !has "recommend", "GET /roles",
    name has "GET /operations/", "GET /operations/{id}",
    name has "GET /operations", "GET /operations",
    name has "POST /recommend" or name has "GET /recommend", "/recommend",
    name has "GET /analytics", "GET /analytics",
    name has "GET /about", "GET /about",
    name has "GET /api/roles", "API: /api/roles",
    name has "GET /api/operations", "API: /api/operations",
    name has "GET /api/", "API: Other",
    name has "GET /static", "Static Assets",
    name has "GET / ", "GET / (Home)",
    name has "GET /healthz", "Healthcheck",
    name
)
| project timestamp, duration, endpoint
| order  by timestamp asc

requests
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| summarize Requests = count() by bin(timestamp, $__interval), name, resultCode
| order by timestamp asc

requests
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where toint(resultCode) >= 500 and toint(resultCode) < 600
| summarize count() by bin(timestamp, $__interval), tostring(resultCode)
| order by timestamp asc

requests
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where toint(resultCode) >= 500 and toint(resultCode) < 600
| summarize count() by name, tostring(resultCode)
| top 8 by count_ desc

requests
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where toint(resultCode) >= 500 and toint(resultCode) < 600
| count

requests
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where toint(resultCode) >= 500
| summarize count() by bin(timestamp, $__interval), tostring(resultCode)
| order by timestamp asc

exceptions
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| summarize count() by bin(timestamp, $__interval), type
| order by timestamp asc

requests
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where toint(resultCode) >= 500
| summarize count() by name, tostring(resultCode)
| top 10 by count_ desc

requests
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where toint(resultCode) >= 400 and toint(resultCode) < 500
| summarize count() by bin(timestamp, $__interval), tostring(resultCode)
| order by timestamp asc

requests
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| extend endpoint = case(
    name has "GET /roles/" and name !has "recommend", "GET /roles/{id}",
    name has "GET /roles" and name !has "recommend", "GET /roles",
    name has "GET /operations/", "GET /operations/{id}",
    name has "GET /operations", "GET /operations",
    name has "POST /recommend" or name has "GET /recommend", "/recommend",
    name has "GET /analytics", "GET /analytics",
    name has "GET /about", "GET /about",
    name has "GET /api/roles", "API: /api/roles",
    name has "GET /api/operations", "API: /api/operations",
    name has "GET /api/", "API: Other",
    name has "GET /static", "Static Assets",
    name has "GET / ", "GET / (Home)",
    name has "GET /healthz", "Healthcheck",
    name
)
| where  resultCode startswith "4"
| summarize count() by endpoint, resultCode
| top 12 by count_ desc

performanceCounters
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where name == "% Processor Time" and category == "Processor"
| where isnotempty(cloud_RoleName) and cloud_RoleName != ""
| summarize p95_value = percentile(value, 95) by bin(timestamp, $__interval)//, cloud_RoleName
| project timestamp, p95_value
| order by timestamp asc

performanceCounters
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where name == "IO Data Bytes/sec" and category == "Process"
| summarize p95_value = percentile(value, 95) by bin(timestamp, $__interval), cloud_RoleName
| project timestamp, cloud_RoleName, p95_value
| order by timestamp asc

performanceCounters
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
//| where (name == "Available Bytes" and category == "Memory") or (name == "Private Bytes" and category == "Process")
| where  (name == "Private Bytes" and category == "Process")
| summarize p95_value = percentile(value, 95) by bin(timestamp, $__interval), cloud_RoleName, name
| extend series = strcat(cloud_RoleName, " - ", replace_string(name, " Bytes", ""))
| extend value_gb = round(p95_value / 1073741824, 2)
| project timestamp, series, value_gb
| evaluate pivot(series, take_any(value_gb))

requests
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| summarize count() by client_Type
| top 6 by count_ desc

requests
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| extend browser = case(
    client_Browser has "Chrome" and client_Browser !has "Edge", "Chrome",
    client_Browser has "Firefox", "Firefox",
    client_Browser has "Safari" and client_Browser !has "Chrome", "Safari",
    client_Browser has "Edge", "Edge",
    client_Browser has "bot" or client_Browser has "Bot" or client_Browser has "curl" or client_Browser has "python", "Bot/Script",
    isempty(client_Browser), "Unknown",
    "Other"
)
| summarize count() by browser
| top 6 by count_ desc

requests
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| extend os = case(
    client_OS has "Windows", "Windows",
    client_OS has "Mac" or client_OS has "iOS", "Apple",
    client_OS has "Linux", "Linux",
    client_OS has "Android", "Android",
    isempty(client_OS), "Unknown",
    "Other"
)
| summarize count() by os
| top 6 by count_ desc

requests
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where name has "recommend" or url has "recommend"
| count

requests
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where name has "recommend" or url has "recommend"

requests

requests

  by bin(timestamp, $__interval)

customMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where name in ("ai_recommendation", "ai_recommendation_error")
| extend mode = tostring(customDimensions.mode)
| extend status = iff(name == "ai_recommendation_error", "error", "success")
| summarize count() by bin(timestamp, $__interval), mode, status
| order by timestamp asc

customMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where name in ("ai_recommendation", "ai_recommendation_error")
| extend mode = tostring(customDimensions.mode)
| extend result_count = toint(customDimensions.result_count)
| summarize calls = count(), successes = countif(name == "ai_recommendation"), avg_results = round(avg(result_count), 1) by mode
| extend success_rate = round(100.0 * successes / calls, 1)
| project mode, calls, success_rate, avg_results
| order by calls desc

customMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where name == "role_recommendation"
| extend operations_count = toint(customDimensions.operations_count)
| extend expanded_count = toint(customDimensions.expanded_count)
| extend result_count = toint(customDimensions.result_count)
| summarize calls = count(), avg_operations = round(avg(operations_count), 1), avg_expanded = round(avg(expanded_count), 1), avg_results = round(avg(result_count), 1)
| project calls, avg_operations, avg_expanded, avg_results

customMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where name in ("ai_recommendation", "ai_recommendation_error")
| extend mode = tostring(customDimensions.mode)
| summarize calls = count() by mode
| order by calls desc

customMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where name in ("ai_recommendation", "ai_recommendation_error")
| extend status = iff(name == "ai_recommendation_error", "error", "success")
| summarize calls = count() by status
| order by calls desc

customMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where name == "ai_recommendation_error"
| extend mode = tostring(customDimensions.mode)
| extend error = tostring(customDimensions.error)
| summarize count = count() by mode, error
| order by count desc

dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| summarize count() by bin(timestamp, $__interval), type
| order by timestamp asc

dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| summarize 
    calls = count(),
    avg_ms = round(avg(duration), 1),
    success_rate = round(countif(toint(resultCode) < 500) * 100.0 / count(), 1)
  by type, target
| top 10 by calls desc

panels.description: Overall cache hit rate percentage across all cache types

azureLogAnalytics.query:
customMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where name == "cache_access"
| extend hit = tobool(customDimensions.hit)
| summarize hits = countif(hit), total = count()
| extend hit_rate = round(100.0 * hits / total, 1)
| project hit_rate

panels.title: Cache Hit Rate %

panels.description: Total cache misses in the selected time range

azureLogAnalytics.query:
customMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where name == "cache_access"
| extend hit = tobool(customDimensions.hit)
| where hit == false
| summarize misses = count()

panels.title: Cache Misses

panels.description: Total DB fallbacks (when cache miss forces database query)

azureLogAnalytics.query:
customMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where name == "db_fallback"
| summarize fallbacks = count()

panels.title: DB Fallbacks

azureLogAnalytics.query:
customMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where name == "db_query_duration_seconds"
| extend duration_ms = round(value * 1000, 1)
| summarize p95_ms = round(percentile(duration_ms, 95), 1)

customMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where name == "cache_refresh_failure"
| summarize failures = count()

customMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where name == "cache_refresh_event"
| summarize refreshes = count()

panels.description: Cache hits vs misses over time by cache type

azureLogAnalytics.query:
customMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where name == "cache_access"
| extend cache_type = tostring(customDimensions.cache_type)
| extend hit = tobool(customDimensions.hit)
| summarize hits = countif(hit), misses = countif(not(hit)) by bin(timestamp, $__interval)
| order by timestamp asc

panels.title: Cache Hits vs Misses Over Time

panels.description: Database query latency by query type over time

azureLogAnalytics.query:
customMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where name == "db_query_duration_seconds"
| extend query_name = tostring(customDimensions.query)
| extend duration_ms = round(value * 1000, 1)
| summarize p95_ms = percentile(duration_ms, 95) by bin(timestamp, $__interval), query_name
| order by timestamp asc

panels.title: DB Query Latency by Type (P95)

panels.description: Cache hit rate breakdown by cache type with visual gauge

azureLogAnalytics.query:
customMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where name == "cache_access"
| extend cache_type = tostring(customDimensions.cache_type)
| extend hit = tobool(customDimensions.hit)
| summarize calls = count(), hits = countif(hit), misses = countif(not(hit)) by cache_type
| extend hit_rate = round(100.0 * hits / calls, 1)
| project cache_type, calls, hits, misses, hit_rate
| order by hit_rate asc

panels.title: Cache Hit Rate by Type

panels.description: Top cache misses by key - identifies which cache lookups fail most often

azureLogAnalytics.query:
customMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where name == "cache_access"
| extend cache_type = tostring(customDimensions.cache_type)
| extend key = tostring(customDimensions.key)
| extend hit = tobool(customDimensions.hit)
| where hit == false
| summarize misses = count() by cache_type, key
| order by misses desc
| take 15

panels.title: Top Cache Misses by Key

panels.description: DB fallbacks when cache miss forces database query

azureLogAnalytics.query:
customMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where name == "db_fallback"
| extend fallback_type = tostring(customDimensions.type)
| extend reason = tostring(customDimensions.reason)
| summarize count = count() by fallback_type, reason
| order by count desc

panels.title: DB Fallbacks by Type & Reason

panels.description: Database query performance breakdown by query type

azureLogAnalytics.query:
customMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where name == "db_query_duration_seconds"
| extend query_name = tostring(customDimensions.query)
| extend duration_ms = round(value * 1000, 1)
| extend rows = toint(customDimensions.rows)
| summarize calls = count(), avg_ms = round(avg(duration_ms), 1), p95_ms = round(percentile(duration_ms, 95), 1), max_ms = round(max(duration_ms), 1), avg_rows = round(avg(rows), 0) by query_name
| order by p95_ms desc

panels.title: DB Query Performance by Type
